statements.impact_statement: Fix commit a14053c9679d is an ancestor of the openbao v2.5.4 tag we build from (GitHub compare v2.5.4...a14053c9679d reports 'behind'), so the patched code ships in this image. govulndb records the fix only as a 0.0.0-20250806 pseudo-version because the openbao module path lacks a /v2 suffix, which makes version-range matchers treat every v2.x tag as affected.

The advisory affects only aws-sdk-go v1's S3 encryption client (service/s3/s3crypto). openbao/openbao contains zero references to s3crypto, and Go links only imported packages into the binary, so the vulnerable code is not present. No fixed aws-sdk-go v1 release exists or is planned (fixed only in aws-sdk-go-v2).
